title: Recursive majority
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$, define a Boolean function on sign vectors of length $n^d$ recursively. At depth zero it returns the sole coordinate of the input; at depth $d+1$, it divides the input into $n$ recursive blocks of length $n^d$, applies the depth-$d$ function to each block, and returns the majority sign of those $n$ values, assigning a tie the value $1$.
